// Transactional outbox: deletion intent commits atomically with its owning row.
export const storageCleanupJobs = pgTable("storage_cleanup_jobs", {
  id: text("id").primaryKey(),
  kind: text("kind").notNull(),
  provider: text("provider").notNull(),
  objectKey: text("object_key").notNull(),
  uploadId: text("upload_id"),
  source: text("source").notNull(),
  status: text("status").notNull().default("pending"),
  attempts: integer("attempts").notNull().default(0),
  availableAt: timestamp("available_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
  leaseUntil: timestamp("lease_until", { withTimezone: true }),
  leaseToken: text("lease_token"),
  lastError: text("last_error"),
  createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
  completedAt: timestamp("completed_at", { withTimezone: true }),
}, table => [index("storage_cleanup_due_idx").on(table.status, table.availableAt)]);

export const videoUploadSessions = pgTable("video_upload_sessions", {
  id: text("id").primaryKey(),
  userId: integer("user_id").notNull().references(() => users.id, { onDelete: "restrict" }),
  clientRequestId: text("client_request_id").notNull(),
  courseSlug: text("course_slug").notNull(),
  lessonId: text("lesson_id").notNull(),
  objectKey: text("object_key").notNull(),
  contentType: text("content_type").notNull(),
  sizeBytes: integer("size_bytes").notNull(),
  checksumsJson: text("checksums_json").notNull(),
  uploadId: text("upload_id"),
  status: text("status").notNull().default("uploading"),
  assetId: integer("asset_id"),
  expiresAt: timestamp("expires_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull(),
  createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
  updatedAt: timestamp("updated_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
}, table => [
  uniqueIndex("video_upload_request_unique").on(table.userId, table.clientRequestId),
  uniqueIndex("video_upload_object_unique").on(table.objectKey),
  index("video_upload_expiry_idx").on(table.status, table.expiresAt),
]);
